Improved Life Tap.sig: Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by #%.

Suppression.sig: Improves your chance to hit by #% and reduces all threat you generate by #%.

Improved Corruption.sig: Reduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by # sec and increases the damage it deals by #%.

Grim Reach.sig: Increases the range of your Affliction spells by #%.

Soul Harvest.t: Drain Soul kills double mana regen for {2} sec
Soul Harvest.sig: Killing a non-trivial target afflicted by your Drain Soul increases your Mana regeneration by #% for # sec and allows #% of normal Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Improved Drains.sig: Increases Health drained, damage done, or Mana drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Drain Mana spells by #%.

Improved Bane of Agony.sig: Increases the damage done by your Bane of Agony by #%.

Fel Concentration.t: {1}% chance to ignore pushback on drains
Fel Concentration.sig: Gives your Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells a #% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

Amplify Curse.t: Next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony {1}% stronger
Amplify Curse.sig: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by #%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by #%. Lasts # sec.

Pandemic.t: +{1}% crit damage on damage over time
Pandemic.sig: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by #%.

Malevolence.sig: Increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by #%.

Nightfall.t: {1}% chance for an instant Shadow Bolt
Nightfall.sig: Gives your Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life, and Wrack spells a #% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by #%.

Curse of Exhaustion.t: Slow the target by {1}% for {2} sec
Curse of Exhaustion.sig: Reduces the target's movement speed by #% for # sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Siphon Life.sig: Transfers # health from the target to the caster every # sec. Lasts # sec.

Soul Siphon.t: Drains +{1}% per Corruption, Siphon Life or Bane on the target
Soul Siphon.sig: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by #% per each of your Corruption, Siphon Life, and Bane of Agony effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of #%.

Shadow Mastery.sig: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by #%.

Wrack.t: Shadow channel; while it runs your Corruption, Siphon Life and Bane tick {4}% faster
Wrack.sig: Tears the target apart from within for # sec, inflicting # Shadow damage every # sec. While channeling, your Siphon Life, Corruption, and Bane of Agony effects on the target deal their periodic damage #% faster.

Improved Health Funnel.sig: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by #%, reduces its health cost by #%, and reduces all threat your Health Funnel generates by #%. Allows Health Funnel to be used regardless of your demon's health.

Improved Imp.sig: Increases the damage of your Imp's Firebolt spell by #% and the effect of its Fire Shield spell by #%.

Unholy Power.sig: Increases all damage done by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by #%.

Demonic Aegis.sig: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Skin and Demon Armor spells by #%.

Improved Voidwalker.sig: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, and Suffering spells by #%.

Fel Vitality.t: Demon health and mana +{1}%, your mana +{2}%
Fel Vitality.sig: Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by #%, and increases your maximum Mana by #%.

Demonic Energies.t: Your spells heal your demon for {1}%
Demonic Energies.sig: You heal your pet for #% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains #% of the Mana you gain.

Improved Sayaad.sig: Increases the effect of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss spells by #%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' and Incubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by #%.

Demonic Sacrifice.t: Sacrifice your demon for a long buff
Demonic Sacrifice.sig: When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts # hrs. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned. Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by #%. Voidwalker: Restores #% of your total Mana every # sec. Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by #%. Felhunter: Restores #% of your total Health every # sec.

Master Summoner.sig: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter Summoning spells by # sec and the Mana cost by #%.

Decimation.t: Soul Fire cooldown {1}% shorter, bonus damage under {2}% health
Decimation.sig: Reduces the cooldown of your Soul Fire spell by #%. When you cast Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below #% health, they deal #% increased damage, and for the next # sec your Soul Fire spell has its cast time reduced by #% and costs no Soul Shards.

Fel Domination.t: Next summon {1} sec faster and {2}% cheaper
Fel Domination.sig: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by # sec and its Mana cost reduced by #%.

Demonic Brand.t: Searing Pain brands the target for your demon
Demonic Brand.sig: Your Searing Pain generates #% less threat and brands the target for # sec. Your pet's next # attacks against the target deal # to # Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet. If Shadow damage is dealt, it has high threat.

Improved Felhunter.sig: Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Felhunter's Tainted Blood, the healing of its Devour Magic, and the detection level of its Paranoia by #%, and reduces the cooldown of its Spell Lock by # sec.

Soul Link.t: Your demon takes {1}% of your damage
Soul Link.sig: When active, #% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict #% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

Demonic Knowledge.t: Spell damage up to {1}% of your level with a demon out
Demonic Knowledge.sig: Increases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to #% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active.

Master Demonologist.t: Bonus for you and your demon, by demon type
Master Demonologist.sig: Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active. Imp - Increases Fire damage done by #%. Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by #%. Succubus/Incubus - Increases Shadow damage done by #%. Felhunter - Reduces Magic damage taken by #%.

Demonic Pact.t: Demonic Sacrifice stays when you summon another demon
Demonic Pact.sig: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.

Destructive Reach.sig: Increases the range of your Destruction spells by #%.

Improved Shadow Bolt.t: Shadow Bolt crits add +{1}% Shadow damage taken for {2} sec
Improved Shadow Bolt.sig: Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage taken by the target from your attacks by #% for # sec.

Bane.t: Shadow Bolt, Immolate and Incinerate {1} sec faster
Bane.sig: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by # sec and your Soul Fire spell by # sec.

Cataclysm.sig: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by #%.

Aftermath.sig: Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by #% and your Conflagrate spell has a #% chance to Daze the target, reducing the target's movement speed by #% for # sec.

Ruin.sig: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by #%.

Shadowburn.t: Instant Shadow hit, a Soul Shard if the target dies
Shadowburn.sig: Instantly blasts the target for # to # Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within # sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

Intensity.t: {1}% chance to ignore pushback on Destruction spells
Intensity.sig: Gives your Destruction spells a #% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

Agonizing Flames.sig: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by #% and the damage done by all your Destruction spells by #%.

Conflagrate.t: Consume Immolate for a big Fire hit
Conflagrate.sig: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing # to # Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

Pyroclasm.t: Soul Fire, Rain of Fire and Hellfire can stun
Pyroclasm.sig: Gives your Soul Fire spell a #% chance to Stun the target for # sec, and your Rain of Fire and Hellfire spells a #% chance over their duration to Stun targets they damage for # sec.

Bane of Havoc.t: {2}% of your damage on others also hits the target
Bane of Havoc.sig: Afflicts the target for # min, causing #% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to # target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Fire and Brimstone.sig: Increases the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell by #%.

Shadow and Flame.t: Conflagrate and Shadowburn give +{1}% damage for {2} sec
Shadow and Flame.sig: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by #% for # sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by #% for # sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a #% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a #% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.

Incinerate.sig: Deals # to # Fire damage to your target and an additional #% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.

_spells.Shadowburn: Instant Shadow hit, Soul Shard on a kill

_spells.Bane of Havoc: Copies part of your damage onto the target

_spells.Wrack: Shadow channel that boosts your damage over time, new in Forever
